label: Order
caption: SAMANTHA ESTEFANIA FRANCISCO CASTRO Applicant V. JOSE LEONARDO BRITO GUEVARA
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, case No. 24-10520, is hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court. It is further ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Thursday, October 16, 2025, by 4 p.m. (EDT).
